name: Open a member sub account
description: Opens a new sub account of a given type for a member, with an opening deposit, and returns the suffix the system assigned. The form is reached by path because MERIDIAN Core links to it from nowhere, so the goal names it.
goal: open a {{inputs.accountType}} sub account for the member whose member ID is {{inputs.memberId}}, with an opening amount of {{inputs.openingAmount}}. Nothing in this application links to the form, so navigate the content frame to /member/{{inputs.memberId}}/subaccount to reach it. Record the suffix the system assigns as the output suffix.

inputs.name: accountType
inputs.description: The kind of sub account to open
